An animal that is neither a red deer nor:
def check_file(json_file):
    individual_tracks = get_tracks_from_json(json_file)
    red_deer_tracks = get_nb_tracks_species_in_video(individual_tracks, species_name=Species.RED_DEER)
    roe_deer_tracks = get_nb_tracks_species_in_video(individual_tracks, species_name=Species.ROE_DEER)
    return len(individual_tracks) - red_deer_tracks - roe_deer_tracks > 0
